description: Users sometimes cannot log in. Please fix ASAP.
As a registered user, I want to reset my password via a link sent to my verified email address so that I can regain access.
acceptance_criteria: Given an existing account, requesting a reset returns a generic confirmation; reset links expire after 30 minutes and can be used once; submitting a valid new password invalidates active sessions; invalid or expired links show a safe error.

description: The dashboard feels slow on some days. Make it faster.

Support reported two card charges for one checkout attempt on 2026-10-29. Payment provider event IDs: synthetic evt_a1 and evt_a2. Steps: submit payment, then retry after a client timeout. Production logs are restricted; reproduce in staging using sandbox cards.
acceptance_criteria: With the same idempotency key, retries create at most one successful charge; payment state is reconciled with provider webhooks; regression tests cover timeout and retry; no real customer data is used in tests.

description: Finance users need an Export CSV action on the invoices table. Columns: invoice_id, issued_at (ISO 8601 UTC), customer_id, currency, amount_minor, status. Export respects active filters and account permissions.
acceptance_criteria: Given 0 rows, export contains headers only; given 200 rows, all filtered authorized rows appear once; UTF-8 with quoted fields; unauthorized requests return 403.

description: Some searches return weird results.
Rotate the service-to-service API credential used by the reporting worker. Store the new value in the secret manager; never print it in logs. Deploy using a dual-key overlap window.
acceptance_criteria: Worker continues processing during rotation; old credential is revoked after deployment validation; audit log records rotation event without credential value; rollback procedure documented.

description: Users asked for dark mode. Make the app look modern.
On /orders with page_size=25, page 2 repeats the last row of page 1 when two orders share created_at. Sorting currently uses created_at only.
acceptance_criteria: Use deterministic ordering by created_at and order_id; navigating page boundaries produces no duplicate or missing records; unit test covers identical timestamps.

description: Research vector databases and recommend one.
When a scheduled import job fails three times consecutively, send an email notification to the organization admins.
acceptance_criteria: Only admins of the affected organization receive the email; send at most one notification per incident; include job ID and link to dashboard but no sensitive payload; reset counter after success.

description: On iPhone SE (375px width), Safari iOS 17, the open menu covers the Checkout submit button. Repro: open Cart > Checkout, tap the menu.
acceptance_criteria: At widths 320–430px, the menu can be closed without obscuring or activating checkout controls; visual regression test covers 375px.

description: We launch on Friday and all bugs must be fixed. Coordinate with the team.
Allow shoppers to check out without an account while collecting email for receipt delivery. Shipping address remains mandatory for physical items.
acceptance_criteria: Guest can complete checkout with valid email; account creation is not required; order confirmation never exposes personal details to other sessions; automated tests cover guest and registered flows.

description: Uploading a CSV with 60,000 rows to /imports returns HTTP 500. The endpoint accepts files up to 15 MB; current server has 30 s timeout. Test file is synthetic.
acceptance_criteria: Requests exceeding 15 MB return 413 with actionable message; valid files within documented limits return 202 and process asynchronously; no unhandled 500; upload error logged with correlation ID.

description: Create a smart assistant that answers anything about the company and never makes mistakes.
Emit checkout_failure_total metric labeled by environment, payment_provider, and normalized_error_code. Do not include user IDs as metric labels.
acceptance_criteria: Metric increments once per failed checkout; dashboard shows rate per 5 minutes; alert fires when failure rate exceeds 3% for 10 minutes with at least 100 attempts.

summary: Date filter missing records around DST
description: Daily sales reports for Europe/Madrid omit orders around the daylight saving transition. Backend converts local midnight directly to UTC using a fixed offset.
acceptance_criteria: Date range conversion uses IANA timezone Europe/Madrid; start inclusive/end exclusive; tests cover March and October transitions; report includes all matching orders once.

description: Make onboarding easier so users finish it more often.

summary: Assess migration from REST to GraphQL
description: Compare REST and GraphQL for the mobile catalog app, considering API latency, caching, client complexity, and operational risk. Deliver a 2-page decision record with recommendation and measurable assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: Decision record includes benchmark plan and at least two alternative options; identifies migration risks; estimates effort and names open questions.

description: Coupon SAVE10 with expires_at=2026-11-01T00:00:00Z was accepted on 2026-11-02. Repro using test clock and synthetic coupon.
acceptance_criteria: Reject expired coupons using UTC timestamps; boundary test at exact expires_at; return stable validation error and do not apply discount.

description: Update all old dependencies to the latest versions immediately.
Organization owners and security admins can view audit logs, while members cannot. Results support pagination and date filtering.
acceptance_criteria: GET /audit-logs returns 403 for members; results only include current organization; pagination is deterministic; filter supports ISO 8601 date range; audit access itself is logged.

description: A few users report receiving two notifications for the same event, but no event IDs or reproduction steps have been provided.
Write a disaster recovery runbook for the order database. RPO target 15 minutes; RTO target 2 hours. Include ownership, failover, and restoration validation.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook identifies owner and escalation contacts by role; staging restoration drill completed; measured recovery time recorded; known gaps and next drill date documented.

description: Support agents can search exact order IDs in their assigned accounts. Accept only canonical order IDs, e.g., ORD-12345.
acceptance_criteria: Exact match returns one authorized order or no results; cross-account searches return no data; invalid format returns 400; p95 latency below 500 ms for test dataset of 100k orders.

description: It crashed once during a demo. Not sure what device or action caused it.
Translate the app into all European languages with no added cost.

summary: Run payment regression suite before release
description: Run the automated payment regression suite against staging commit abc123 with sandbox provider, attach results to release checklist, and block deployment on failed critical tests.
acceptance_criteria: 100% of critical payment tests pass; evidence contains run ID, commit SHA, and timestamps; any critical failure creates a linked blocker ticket.

description: Retry delivery of failed outbound webhooks with exponential backoff, capped at 5 attempts over 1 hour. Expose delivery state to admins.
acceptance_criteria: A successful webhook stops retries; duplicate deliveries carry the same event ID; failed deliveries after final attempt are visible; secrets excluded from logs; tests cover transient 5xx and permanent 4xx.

description: Customer billed in GBP receives a receipt with EUR symbol. Observed only when account locale is es-ES.
Enable avatar uploads: JPEG/PNG, maximum 2 MB, crop to square, accessible alt text defaults to display name.
acceptance_criteria: Reject unsupported types with 415; reject oversized file with 413; generate 128px and 512px renditions; files are private until authorized view; remove EXIF metadata.

description: Database queries are inefficient. Fix the slow ones.
With stock=1, two simultaneous checkout requests can both reserve the last unit. Load test reproduces with parallel requests.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one reservation succeeds when stock=1; other gets out-of-stock response; concurrent test with 100 workers shows no negative stock; no deadlocks on retries.

description: Customer service can issue partial refunds for settled card payments. The aggregate refunded amount may not exceed captured amount.
acceptance_criteria: Only authorized agents can refund; refunds are idempotent; amounts use minor currency units; audit records actor and reason; refund above remaining balance is rejected.

description: The analytics widget says error sometimes. Please look into it.
Workspace admins can archive up to 100 completed tasks in one operation; active or already archived tasks are skipped with per-item reasons.
acceptance_criteria: Returns per-item success/failure results; 100-item operation completes within 10 s on staging; only workspace admins can invoke; partial errors do not roll back successful items.

description: Set up centralized application logs for the worker service and establish searchable correlation IDs. Mask emails and authorization tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Logs searchable within 2 minutes; no raw tokens or email addresses; retention set to 30 days in staging; alert includes link to filtered logs.

description: Responses should be instant, ideally zero latency.
User from organization A can access organization B invoice by changing numeric invoice ID in GET /invoices/{id}/pdf. Confirmed in staging using synthetic accounts.
acceptance_criteria: All invoice PDF reads enforce organization and role authorization; cross-tenant access returns 404 or 403 consistently; security regression test added; incident escalated to security owner.

description: Add export for audit events filtered by date and actor, capped at 10,000 records per job. Generated CSV expires after 24 hours.
acceptance_criteria: Exports are available only to security admins; all rows belong to the requesting organization; download uses expiring authorized URL; files are deleted after expiry.

summary: App crashes on startup after update
description: On Android 14 version 2.7.1 build 310, app crashes on launch when migration from local schema v5 to v6 runs with empty cache. Reproduced on Pixel 7 emulator.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh install and upgrade from v5 both start successfully; corrupted cache is handled without data loss; crash-free launch test covers Android 13 and 14.

description: Users can attach up to five files per comment. File size limit and permitted types are not decided; product owner approval is pending.

summary: Slow report generation for large accounts
description: Quarterly reports for accounts with over 1 million transactions take 4–6 minutes. Business requires under 30 seconds, but the architecture approach is undecided.
acceptance_criteria: For benchmark account with 1 million synthetic transactions, p95 generation completes in under 30 seconds; output totals match reference query; peak memory stays below 1 GB.

description: Integrate axe-core scan into CI for checkout pages on desktop and mobile viewports.
acceptance_criteria: CI fails on new critical and serious accessibility violations; report uploaded as artifact; existing baseline exceptions documented with owner and expiry.

description: Provide explicit toggles for analytics and marketing consent while keeping essential cookies always enabled. Preferences persist per account.
acceptance_criteria: Analytics and marketing default off for new users; consent change is audited; optional trackers do not load without permission; users can withdraw consent later.

description: Users say error messages are bad. Need more friendly wording.
Evaluate global and per-tenant API rate limiting for public endpoints. Compare token bucket and fixed window with traffic simulation and fairness considerations.
acceptance_criteria: Provide decision record, experiment results, suggested limits by tier, and monitoring recommendations.

description: Add Claude to summarize customer support tickets. Nothing decided about PII, pricing, rate limits, or whether summaries are editable.
Analysts can save up to 10 named report-filter presets per account and apply one from a dropdown.
acceptance_criteria: Preset names must be unique within an account; saved filters restore all supported filter values; users cannot edit other users private presets; max 10 enforced.
